page.title: Settings
page.description: Company details, invoice texts, rates, lists, users and integrations — all stored in the database.

validation.amount: Enter an amount in euros, e.g. 1500 or 1500,00

company.title: Company
company.description: These details print on invoices, receipts and reports.
company.detailsHint: Finnish invoices must show the Business ID, VAT number, address and bank details.
company.name: Company name
company.oldNameHint: Shown as "formerly …" so customers recognise the company.
company.businessIdHint: Format 1234567-8; the check digit is verified.
company.businessIdInvalid: Not a valid Business ID — check the digits and the format 1234567-8
company.vatNumberHint: FI + the Business ID digits without the dash, e.g. FI12345678.
company.vatNumberInvalid: Not a valid VAT number — start with the country code, e.g. FI12345678
company.ibanHint: Required on invoices. Spaces are removed when saved.
company.bicInvalid: Not a valid BIC (8 or 11 characters)
company.logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP, about 200 KB at most. Used on invoices and receipts.
company.removeLogoConfirm: Remove the logo? Invoices and receipts will print without it.
company.logoTooLarge: The image is {{size}} KB — please use a file of about 200 KB or less
company.logoReadFailed: The file could not be read

invoice.title: Invoice texts
invoice.description: Numbering, payment terms and the bilingual texts printed on every invoice.
invoice.numberingHint: Invoice numbers run per year and are assigned automatically.
invoice.yearHint: "year" means numbers like {{example}} — restarts every January.
invoice.termsDaysHint: Due date = invoice date + these days, unless changed on the invoice.
invoice.reminderDaysHint: A reminder email is queued once an invoice is this many days overdue.
invoice.textsHint: The invoice's language decides which version is printed.

rates.title: Rates & salaries
rates.description: Effective-dated rates: add a new row with a later valid-from date instead of changing history.
rates.vatHint: The default series sets the rate on each date; special rates (e.g. 0 %) are offered as options.
rates.noVatHint: Add the general rate first, e.g. 25,5 % valid from 1.9.2024.
rates.label: Label
rates.rateInUse: This rate is used by existing entries and cannot be deleted
rates.rateInUseLong: Entries already use this rate, so deleting it would break their history. Add a new rate with a later valid-from date instead.
rates.deleteConfirm: Delete {{rate}} valid from {{date}}? This is only possible when no entry uses the rate.
rates.taxHint: Used for the tax estimate on the dashboard and P&L.
rates.noTaxHint: Add the current corporate tax rate, e.g. 20 %.
rates.badPct: Enter a percentage between 0 and 100, e.g. 25,5
rates.labelHint: Optional, e.g. "General rate" or "0 % reverse charge".
rates.isDefault: Part of the default rate series
rates.isDefaultHint: Untick for special rates (exempt, reduced) that staff pick manually.
rates.taxDialogHint: The newest rate whose valid-from date has passed is used.

salaries.title: Partner salaries
salaries.hint: Monthly salaries shown as an expense in the P&L, from the valid-from date onwards.
salaries.emptyHint: Add a monthly salary for a partner to include it in profit calculations.
salaries.noPartners: Add a money holder of kind "Partner" under Lists first.
salaries.validFromHint: Replaces the partner's earlier salary from this date.
salaries.deleteConfirm: Delete the salary of {{name}} ({{amount}} per month from {{date}})? Profit figures will be recalculated without it.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: The choices shown in dropdowns across the app. Deactivated rows stay on old records but are no longer offered.
lists.emptyHint: Add the first row to make it available in the forms.
lists.systemHint: Built-in row: it can be renamed or deactivated, but not deleted.
lists.activeHint: Inactive rows stay on existing records but are hidden from new forms.
lists.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate "{{name}}"? Existing records keep it, but it is no longer offered in forms. You can activate it again at any time.
lists.modelsHint: Business models group income (Rental, Repair, Spare parts …) on the dashboard.
lists.codeHint: Capital letters, numbers and underscore. Cannot be changed later.
lists.codeImmutable: The code is permanent — reports and the importer rely on it.
lists.codeInvalid: Use 2–40 capital letters, numbers or underscores
lists.colorHint: Optional — leave empty to use the default palette.
lists.holdersHint: The "Amount received by" options — who holds the money until it reaches the company account.
lists.name: Name
lists.renameHolderHint: The VAT default for this holder (POS & cash) moves to the new name automatically.
lists.methodsHint: How customers pay. The VAT-invoice default pre-fills "VAT invoice issued?" on income forms.
lists.defaultVatInvoiceLabel: Default "VAT invoice issued?" to Yes for this method
lists.defaultVatInvoiceHint: For example bank transfers to the company account usually come with a VAT invoice. Staff can still override it on each sale.
lists.categoriesHint: Expense types used on the expense form and in the P&L.
lists.prefixesHint: Brand → unit-ID prefix used when generating unit codes (e.g. EE2-251001).
lists.prefixHint: Capital letters and numbers, up to 10 characters.
lists.prefixEditHint: Changing the prefix only affects new units; existing codes stay as they are.
lists.brandNameHint: Matched against the brand typed on a new unit.

kindHint.PARTNER: An owner who may receive customer money personally — tracked until handed over.
kindHint.COMPANY: The company bank account — money received here is settled.
kindHint.CASHBOX: Physical cash kept at the shop until deposited.
kindHint.OTHER: Any other holder, e.g. a payment platform balance.

users.title: Users
users.description: Accounts are created by an admin; there is no self sign-up.
users.listHint: Deactivating a user or resetting a password signs them out everywhere.
users.name: Name
users.emailLocked: The sign-in email cannot be changed.
users.languageHint: The app opens in this language after sign-in.
users.maxDiscountHint: The largest total discount this staff member may give at the POS.
users.discountInvalid: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 100

roleHelp.ADMIN: Everything: settings, users, partners, cash settlements, imports and integrations.
roleHelp.STAFF: Daily work: POS, quick entry, rentals, invoices, units and inventory. Discounts are capped.
roleHelp.ACCOUNTANT: Read-only access to the numbers, VAT and reports, plus exports.

users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Share it with the user securely.
users.resetPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password. At least 8 characters.
users.passwordResetOk: Saved — the new password is active and old sessions were signed out
users.activeHint: Inactive users cannot sign in; their history stays.
users.selfGuard: You cannot deactivate your own account.
users.selfRoleGuard: You cannot change your own role — ask another admin.

pos.title: POS & cash
pos.description: Receipt printing, cash alerts, VAT defaults and the profit-calculation switches.
pos.receiptHint: Match the roll width of the thermal printer.
pos.askCustomer: Ask for a customer at checkout
pos.askCustomerHint: Shows the customer picker before payment (still optional for walk-in sales).
pos.cashHint: Warns on the dashboard when a partner holds customer money too long.
pos.alertAfterDaysHint: Days since the oldest unsettled receipt.
pos.vatDefaultsHint: Ticked = "VAT invoice issued?" starts as Yes when this holder receives the money. Staff can still change it.
pos.noHoldersHint: Add them under Lists → Money holders.
pos.pnlHint: How the dashboard and reports calculate profit.
pos.countUnitPurchasesHint: The Excel toggle: subtract scooter/bike purchase prices from profit. Off = purchases are treated as investments.
pos.allocateSharedHint: Spreads costs without a model across models by their share of revenue. Off = shared costs appear only in the "All models" view.
pos.partnerPayable: Company owes partners for personal spending
pos.partnerPayableHint: Business expenses a partner paid personally are shown as payable to that partner.
pos.subtractParts: Subtract repair parts from unit payback
pos.subtractPartsHint: Payback = rental earnings minus parts used on the unit. Off = earnings only.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Partners can log income and expenses by sending a WhatsApp message.
whatsapp.allowedHint: Only messages from these numbers are processed; others are rejected.
whatsapp.noNumbersHint: Add a number in international format to start using WhatsApp entry.
whatsapp.formatHint: International format with country code, e.g. +358401234567.
whatsapp.invalidNumber: Use international format: + and country code, e.g. +358401234567
whatsapp.duplicateNumber: This number is already on the list
whatsapp.fixInvalid: Fix the highlighted numbers before saving
whatsapp.removeConfirm: Remove {{number}} from the allow-list? Messages from it will be rejected after you save.
whatsapp.summaryHint: Each allowed number receives the day's totals every evening.
whatsapp.webhookHint: Paste this URL into the Meta developer console (WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook).
whatsapp.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text and copy it manually
whatsapp.envHint: These secrets live in the server environment, never in the database. Ask whoever runs the server to set them.

env.WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN: — the verify token you also type into Meta's webhook form.
env.WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET: — the app secret, used to check message signatures.
env.WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN: — the access token for sending replies.
env.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: — the ID of the business phone number that sends replies.

whatsapp.inboxHint: Received messages, rejects and the test simulator are in the inbox.

sheets.title: Google Sheet
sheets.description: A read-only mirror of the data in a Google Sheet. The database stays the master.
sheets.configHint: Each sync fully rewrites the tabs Entries, Expenses, Rentals, Units, Payments, Handovers and Summary.
sheets.sheetIdHint: The long ID from the sheet's address — you can also paste the whole URL.
sheets.idRequired: Enter the sheet ID to enable syncing
sheets.idInvalid: This does not look like a Google Sheet ID
sheets.serviceAccountHint: The server signs in with a service account (GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE). Share the sheet with that account's email as an editor.
sheets.notConfigured: Google Sheets sync is not configured
sheets.inProgress: A sync is already running — try again in a moment
sheets.noLogsHint: Press "Sync now" once the sheet is configured.

email.title: Email
email.description: Outgoing mail for invoices and reminders.
email.smtpHint: Get these from your email provider. Emails are queued and sent in the background.
email.secureHint: Leave off for port 587 — the connection is upgraded with STARTTLS.
email.passHint: Use an app password if your provider offers one.
email.fromHint: Name and address shown to customers, e.g. E Motion Works Oy <info@example.fi>.
email.envFallback: Empty fields fall back to the server's SMTP_* environment variables.

import.title: Import
import.description: Bring the historical Excel workbook into the system and review what needs attention.
import.uploadHint: The .xlsx with the clean tabs Unit Data, Rental Data, Sales Data and Cost Data (max 20 MB).
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB
import.runningHint: This can take a minute. Keep this page open.
import.phonesNote: Customer phone numbers are never imported from the Excel (GDPR).
import.confirmMessage: Import "{{file}}"? Every row is added to the database. Importing the same workbook twice creates duplicates.
import.batchesHint: Open a report to see issues and the rows that need review.
import.noBatchesHint: Upload the workbook above to run the first import.

about.title: About
about.description: System information and the privacy notice.
about.principle1: All amounts are stored in euro cents, so totals always add up exactly.
about.principle2: Nothing is deleted: entries are voided with a reason and every change is in the audit log.
about.principle3: VAT rates and salaries are effective-dated, so old periods keep their original numbers.
about.principle4: Money received personally by a partner is tracked until it is handed over to the company.
about.privacyHint: The notice shown to customers, in the current language.

report.title: Import report
report.notFoundHint: Open the report from the list of imports.
report.noSummaryHint: This import may have stopped before it finished. Check the issues below.
report.totalsHint: Compare these with the totals in the Excel — they should match to the cent.
report.issuesHint: Grouped by severity, with the sheet and row in the Excel.

severityHint.review: Imported, but marked for checking — fix them in the tables below.
severityHint.warning: Rows that were skipped or adjusted. Compare with the Excel.
severityHint.info: Background information about how the data was interpreted.

report.unitsHint: Open the unit and complete the missing details.
report.entriesHint: Rental rows are fixed in Rentals; other income in Add entry → latest entries.
report.expensesHint: Open the expense and add the missing details or receipt.
report.phonesHint: Recorded in the audit log as part of the GDPR trail.
report.phonesBody: Customer phone numbers were not imported. The original rental tab still has them, but copying them needs a lawful basis. Record whether phone numbers may be added manually (with the customer's consent) or should stay out of the system.
report.phonesConfirm: Phones may be added manually with consent
report.phonesConfirmMessage: Record that customer phone numbers may be added manually, one by one, with the customer's consent?
report.phonesDeclineMessage: Record that customer phone numbers stay out of the system?
report.phonesConfirmedOk: Decision recorded: phones may be added manually with consent
report.phonesDeclinedOk: Decision recorded: phone numbers stay out
report.phonesRecordedYes: Recorded: phone numbers may be added manually with consent.
report.phonesRecordedNo: Recorded: phone numbers stay out of the system.
